name: Faith Teams
shortDescription: A church management suite with people, groups, giving, check-in, communications, volunteer scheduling and service planning.
suitableContexts: Churches wanting people, volunteer and communication tools in one subscription

pricing.summary: Faith Teams publishes US-dollar prices by active people, with a 10-day no-card trial.

editorial.assessment: Faith Teams publishes a clear active-person pricing model and broad operational feature set. UK churches should verify payment availability, Gift Aid, data-processing terms and the implications of US-based support before use.
bestFor: Churches wanting one subscription for people, groups and service workflows
strengths: Broad people, check-in and planning coverage
limitations: UK finance and compliance fit not confirmed

longForm.verdict: Faith Teams is worth a focused trial when a church wants its people, groups, check-in and volunteer workflows in one place. Its active-person pricing makes data counting the first task.

decisionLens.heading: The active-person definition should match the church’s data practice.
decisionLens.text: A price that appears simple can change if the church’s database keeps occasional attenders, historic records or multiple household members active. Count the actual records before comparing plans.

sections.heading: A short, practical trial
sections.question: Can the team test shared workflows in ten days?
paragraphs: Faith Teams publishes a ten-day trial, with people, giving, attendance, check-in, communications, volunteers and service planning in its plan description.
Use a limited test dataset and rehearse an event, check-in and volunteer schedule. Keep UK payment and Gift Aid questions separate until the supplier confirms them.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not use an independent review score; it is based on supplier pricing and feature information.
themes: The trial should test team hand-offs rather than isolated screens.
userFeedback.caveat: Supplier feature claims are not independent testing or proof of UK fit.

faq.question: Does Faith Teams have a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. Faith Teams advertises a ten-day trial without a credit card.

faq.question: How is Faith Teams priced?
faq.answer: The supplier publishes US-dollar tiers by active people, starting at $75/month for up to 499 active people.

faq.question: Does Faith Teams support UK Gift Aid?
faq.answer: Not confirmed in this profile. Verify UK payment, Gift Aid and finance workflows directly.

seo.description: Independent Faith Teams profile for UK churches: pricing, trial, people and volunteer tools, key checks and FAQs.
